$comment: The FaultMaven API contract this client is written against. Moving `ref` is how this repository ADOPTS a contract change: the backend publishes by merging, and nothing reaches this client until this file says so. See docs/reference/api/openapi.json in the API repo, and its docs/development/api-contract-changes.md for the process.
$note: This client implements the contract-9.0.0 menu rule (RESOLVED is not user-selectable) while still PINNED to 6.2.0, deliberately and only in that direction: it hides a control, which is safe against a backend that still accepts the request, and it lands before the backend change so the reverse window — a live control the API 422s — never opens. The consequence is that api.generated.ts still carries 6.2.0's description of suggests_alternative ('warn and offer the alternative'), which the client no longer implements, and no gate can see that: the drift job only checks the pinned version against the pinned ref. Reconciled when the pin moves to 9.0.0 after FaultMaven/faultmaven#1624 merges.
